name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion typically take?
description: A tub-to-shower conversion typically takes 3-5 days for basic projects, but can extend to 1-2 weeks for custom tile work or plumbing reconfigurations.

mainEntity.name: How long does a tub-to-shower conversion typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a tub-to-shower conversion can vary based on the project's scope and the specific materials chosen. A straightforward conversion using pre-fabricated shower surrounds and a basic shower pan might be completed in as little as 3-5 days. However, projects involving custom tile work, significant plumbing reconfigurations, or structural changes can extend to 1-2 weeks or even longer. Your contractor will provide a more precise timeline after evaluating your bathroom and discussing your design preferences. Minimizing bathroom downtime is often a priority for our team.
